label: F08#3 GPU Medium
brief: Five sky-island settlement stands in Cloudreach (three in the upper cliff town, two in the lower cliff village), each by day (left) and night (right), with the 1.80 m trainer as a ruler. Judge whether the settlements and their cliffs read as distinct, lived-in places with their own identity in the key art's world.
defects: The fixed stands' foregrounds are flat lawn or bare dirt, so the settlement does not start at the viewer's feet
Some night frames stay flat moon-blue instead of reading as lamp-lit, inhabited settlements
Under the warm lamps the night road reads rust-red, close to the oxblood reserved for the enemy faction
Window glow blows out to flat white instead of reading as lit windows
